title: River Development Agent governed executor integration operation execution authorization foundation
objective: Establish a default-deny inert authorization boundary between the trusted DEV-306 governed executor invocation and a future operation execution boundary.
requirements: Consume the exact trusted DEV-306 executor invocation result.
Require DEV-306 trusted, ready, and invoked state.
Require the embedded DEV-305 executor invocation authorization to remain trusted, ready, and authorized.
Produce an explicit operation execution authorization state.
Default to DENY whenever predecessor invariants are not satisfied.
Represent authorization as inert data only.
Do not grant shell, network, retry, persistence, push, deployment, secret-access, scope-expansion, or external-side-effect authority.
Require a future operation execution boundary before any actual execution.
